Resolves #18610
Refs #18605

Operator and Review are declared perspectives. Their buttons bind `dock.perspective.active`, clicks write `activePerspective`, and the toolbar renders `modified`. Saved snapshots keep their library restore path; only collection changes reconcile their buttons, with one explicit toolbar update after the batch.

Evidence: L3 achieved and required — real Chrome plus Neural Link, including save/restore/reload/delete and retained DOM identity. Residual: none for this leaf.
Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029 §§2.1–2.2.
Change class: capability.

## Deltas from ticket
Seeded saved records are replaced by declarations, so a fresh snapshot collection is empty. Returning storage whose ids or aliases collide with captured declarations or the reserved prefix fails closed: it is neither applied nor rewritten during load, and the toolbar reports "Saved layouts unavailable". This example owns the declared-name check through `Workspace.declaredPerspectives()` and the shared `Persistence.reservedNameErrors`; generated snapshot ids skip declared names. It does not assume static collection helpers know the declaration set.

Deletion only changes the saved collection and its pointer, never the live document. The control names its target (for example, "Delete Saved 2") and is disabled when empty. Declared buttons derive from the captured list; snapshot placement derives from the Modified component's position. Empty storage hydration and supplied-document precedence remain covered. Collection membership batches explicitly update the toolbar after the per-projection sweep is removed.

The declaration test also forbids the removed membership sweep while real Workspace bindings handle selection and resize. Prior-art memory `d6a71273-b9f2-49bb-b7cd-67f7a66cedcb` identified the stable-toolbar boundary; rendered retention is checked here.
